items.html: And the matter of this clarification depends on the upper thought, which is Aba, as it is written, “in the thought all of them are clarified.” For indeed, the Yesod of Aba brings out the drop of the Mochin to form the fetus from it, and the father is the one who clarifies with his Mochin, which are called thought, and he clarifies the good and casts it into the mouth of the mother; and he gives it into Ima, and she becomes pregnant from him. And afterward, when they are in the womb of the upper mother, throughout all those months, it is clarified further.
